invariants: Every claim has a stable claim ID, topic ID, polarity, text and one or more exact source factor IDs.
Duplicate claim IDs and missing source factor provenance fail closed.
A topic containing both supportive and challenging claims is marked mixed.
Mixed topics preserve every claim and source factor separately; the aggregator never invents one definitive conclusion.
Topic groups and claims are sorted deterministically so the same factor set yields the same presentation order.
remaining_before_done: Exact Flutter test SUCCESS must be visible on the tested commit.
Domain interpretation catalogs must emit claim/topic/polarity metadata and exact calculation-factor IDs before their contradiction handling is DONE.
UI and PDF must render mixed-topic factors separately rather than flattening them into a single certainty statement.
